notes_list.title: Basics: Hardware, I/O, Internet, IP
notes_list.basic_overview: History, introduction and application of Computer, IT, Internet and WWW. Hardware and software; input and output; Internet Protocol / IP address.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Also: IT gadgets and their applications; creating an e-mail ID and using e-mail; operation of printer, tablet and mobile.

notes_list.title: Apps, Security and New Technology
notes_list.basic_overview: MS-Word and MS-Excel important elements; operating system, social networking, e-governance; digital financial tools and applications.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Future skills and cyber security; technology developments: Artificial Intelligence, Big Data Processing, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Internet of Things and India's achievements in the field.
